content: Bulk import duplicate detection: exact-match on a free-text field like company name is fragile because the same company appears with formatting variants (case, suffixes like LTDA/S.A., punctuation, whitespace). Best practice is to normalize into a 'dedup key' (lowercase, strip punctuation/whitespace, strip legal-entity suffixes) before comparing, and prefer a real unique identifier (tax ID/domain/email) over name-only matching when available; combining the normalized name with a second discriminating field (e.g. city/state) reduces false positives.
